plan.title: SRC-CRE-018 Negative Quantity in Reverse Auction

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case.
Configure the event as a reverse buy auction with rank-based bidding.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create test.
Apply the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product with the invalid negative quantity to trigger inline validation.
Assert that Procol rejects the negative quantity with a quantity-related validation error.
